title: Recoupment Dispute and Overpayment Refund Timelines — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
Payer takebacks and overpayments on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) run on payer-class timelines.

| Payer class | Takeback may be disputed within (calendar days after the remittance date that carried it) | Identified overpayment refunded within (calendar days of identification) | Payer may recover by offsetting a later remittance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 60 | 30 | yes |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 60 | 30 | yes |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 60 | 30 | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Plan Claim | 60 | 60 | yes |
| Original Medicare Claim | 120 | 60 | yes |
| BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim | 60 | 60 | yes |
| Wisconsin Workers' Compensation Claim | 60 | 30 | no (the payer must request a refund) |

Example (hypothetical): a takeback carried on a remittance dated the 1st of a month can be disputed on an Original Medicare Claim for 120 days after that date, but for 60 days on a Commercial PPO Claim.
